name: MiniMax H3 — transform a video by reference + audio
description:
Upload a source clip and describe how to transform it. MiniMax H3 watches your clip as a reference (call it "Video 1" in the prompt) and generates a new video that keeps what you ask it to keep — choreography, timing, camera move — and replaces what you describe: character, costume, setting, lighting, style. A new audio track is generated from your prompt.

Nothing is traced frame by frame (unlike the ControlNet versions), so the wording matters a lot: say explicitly what to retain from Video 1 and what to change. The default prompt shows a structure that works well — subject definitions, summary, what to retain, a detailed description and the audio.

This is the slowest MiniMax workflow: the whole reference clip rides along every sampling step. Keep clips short ("Duration", default 5 s; only the start of your clip is used) and use "Fast mode" (4-step turbo LoRA) when you are exploring ideas.

promptGuides.label: MiniMax H3 reference-mode prompt guide — MiniMax
promptGuides.tip: Say what to keep from each input and what changes; describe the action, camera and sound concretely — everything should be visible or audible.

promptGuides.label: H3 prompt tips for ComfyUI — Comfy-Org

exposedParameters.label: Source video (Video 1 - the clip to transform)
Prompt (what to keep from Video 1, what to change, sound)
exposedParameters.default:
[subject_definitions]
- Video 1: Source video of a dancer performing on a cloudy urban rooftop.

[summary]
Transform the dancer into a sleek, high-tech combat android dancing on the roof of a neon-drenched cyberpunk megacity at night.

[retention_analysis]
- Retain the exact dance choreography, rhythmic body pops, head turns, hand gestures, and footwork from Video 1.
- Retain the camera distance, slight handheld panning, and shot timing from Video 1.
- Replace the character's clothing and appearance, and completely overhaul the background and lighting.

[detailed_description]
The dancer is now an advanced humanoid cyborg with matte-black carbon fiber armor plating, subtle glowing crimson circuits across the torso and arms, and luminous ocular sensors. He performs the sharp popping and fluid waving dance routine with robotic precision. The scene takes place at night on a rain-slicked skyscraper helipad high above a sprawling futuristic city. Holographic billboards, flying hovercraft light trails, and vibrant cyan and magenta neon signs illuminate the wet concrete surface with sharp reflections. 

[audio]
Deep 808 synthwave beat with heavy kicks matching the dancer's body pops, mechanical servo whirs on sharp arm gestures, distant sci-fi city hum, and damp footsteps on wet metal.
